# Assignment

## Summary
A piece of work: brief, Due Window, required flag, resubmission flag, rubric link; `effectiveMaxPoints` falls back to the rubric total.

## Usage
Linked from Module.assignments; Submissions link back.

## Non-goals
Does not hold submissions.

## Example
The linked example is a cohort-analysis assignment graded against a rubric, so its max points come from the rubric total.
